reviews.title: Annoying questions
reviews.text:
As soon as I’m required to leave a review it’s going to be a 1 star. After every workout I HAVE TO rate it. Why???
1 star. 
When I start a workout the same question all the time of turning on music. Why?? Just start the workout like I TAPPED to do.
Am I overreacting? Maybe. But I hate when I’m forced to rate. And if I don’t rate it wont let me finish the workout. So yes even if I like the app and the workout, it’s going to be 1 star!!
There should be an option “don’t ask again” because this is ridiculous for the price you’re paying for this app.

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: I honestly hate this app. I love the workouts but the app itself is too convoluted to navigate that I end up just shutting it and doing my own workout to avoid the hassle. If it were half the price I might have still paid for it.

reviews.title: Too much talking about nonsense
reviews.text: Little  variety or any help to guide you on weight or the proper motions in advance.  Coaches never stop talking but it’s never about the actual exercise and they just repeat the same nonsense

reviews.title: 20 minute workout needed
reviews.text:
I find a lot of the workouts are similar when you get into a team. And I wish there was a 20 minute workout
Option with a coach. Beachbody has one with Joel Freeman and it’s my favourite. Would love something like that on here.

reviews.title: Workouts
reviews.text: Nice app. Downloaded it as been weight training 30 years and a level 4 PT. I wanted to see what the fuss was about. The routines were nothing more than chat gpt generation. I train 4 days and there was no clue as to what the week training schedule would be. First workout was a very basic chest / back routine.

reviews.title: Great workouts, but it feels like a dating site
reviews.text: Tried for a month. The workouts were great, but I will not renewing it. If there was a way to turn off the community chat, that would be a game changer. I just want to work out on my own time and am not looking to connect with others. And why do I have to rate every single workout to complete it?

reviews.title: Charge
reviews.text: I canceled my free trial I hope I won’t get charged

reviews.title: Only good online
reviews.text:
The programs are really good and I enjoy not having to think about planning my own workouts but I’m in the military (navy) so on ship we don’t have wifi in our gym 

That’s why I subscribed to this app, because there is an option to download the workouts. But when I go to start them in the gym the app won’t open unless I go back to the wifi area on ship and then when I finish the workout if I connect to wifi after to complete it all of my weight and set info gets deleted and I have to try to remember everything I did during my workout. 

Other than that it’s a great app but very disappointed to be paying so much for something that I thought was going to work good offline.

reviews.title: Terrible support team
reviews.text:
The support team did not do the job. I asked the problem because When I press the volume button during a workout video on my iPhone 17, it accidentally advances to the next step instead of adjusting the volume.
They asked me to change setting and there was no option. The no any response since 7th August, today is 24 August! There is no other way to contact them so I had to leave a comment here!
